outcome: length of time (minutes) to vaginal delivery
cohort: Women with obesity undergoing induction of labor at ≥37 weeks of gestation
finding: There was no difference in time to delivery between the low-dose and high-dose oxytocin protocols in either the lean cohorts or cohorts with obesity undergoing induction of labor.
mod_finding: A trend toward a lower rate of cesarean delivery was observed in both lean women and women with obesity when high-dose oxytocin was used.
